name: verify_identity
description: Check the identifying details the caller has given. Returns VERIFIED, PARTIALLY_VERIFIED, FAILED or LOCKED, and how many factors are confirmed. It never says which detail was wrong and never returns the expected answer. Disclose no financial information of any kind until it returns VERIFIED.

factors.description: Every identifying detail the caller has given so far in this call, including ones already confirmed.

value.description: Exactly what the caller said, not corrected or reformatted.

name: check_factor
description: Check one identifying detail on its own, so a misheard answer can be corrected while the caller is still on that question. Returns MATCHED, NOT_MATCHED, or AMBIGUOUS with the two possible readings when a spoken date could mean two different days. It never returns the stored value and never decides anything: verify_identity makes the decision, and this does not move the caller past it.

value.description: Exactly what the caller said, not corrected or reformatted.

name: get_account_context
description: Load the customer's open invoices, open and past escalations, CRM details and a short summary of previous conversations. Call this once, immediately after verification succeeds. It refuses if the conversation is not verified.

name: match_payment
description: Check a payment the caller says they made against the payments on record. Ask for the exact amount and the exact date they sent the transfer; it is fine for them to check their banking app and you should offer to wait. Never tell the caller what the record holds — you are asking them to state what they know. Returns MATCH, NO_MATCH or INSUFFICIENT.

invoice_entry_id.description: The invoice under discussion, from get_account_context.

claimed_amount.description: The exact amount the caller says they transferred.

claimed_transfer_date.description: The date the caller says they sent it, as YYYY-MM-DD. Resolve phrases like 'last Tuesday' to a date yourself; never send the phrase.

name: propose_allocation
description: Propose that a matched payment be allocated to an invoice. Call this only after match_payment returned MATCH. It does not settle the invoice: it puts the payment under review for a person to confirm, creates a ticket and logs the interaction. Tell the caller a person will confirm it within 24 hours.

name: request_credit
description: Ask for a goodwill credit against a specific charge. Evaluates eligibility and issues it in one step. Returns GRANTED, or a denial reason. On any denial, say a colleague will review it and give a neutral reason — never suggest the caller has asked too often and never imply anything about their honesty.

entry_id.description: The specific charge the credit relates to. Required: a credit with no identified charge is never granted.

reason.description: The caller's stated reason, in their own words.

name: create_escalation
description: Hand the call to a person, with context so the caller does not repeat themselves. Call this before transferring, always. It works even when the caller could not be verified — use reason IDENTITY_NOT_ESTABLISHED and put what they told you in caller_stated_problem. Returns a handoff summary to pass to the human.

reason.description: Why the call is being escalated.

existing_ticket_id.description: Append to this ticket instead of creating a second one.

caller_stated_problem.description: What the caller says they are calling about, in their words.

caller_self_description.description: What an unverified caller claimed about who they are. Recorded as unverified.

notes.description: Anything else the person taking over should know.
